transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been having a really hard time coping with some major stress in my life recently. Ever since a big change occurred, I feel completely overwhelmed and like I'm just not handling things well at all.
Can you tell me what the big change was and when it happened? Also, did your symptoms start soon after that event?

It was a major life change that happened about two months ago, though I'd prefer not to get into the specific details of the event itself right now. Yes, my symptoms started almost immediately after it happened, definitely within a few weeks of that change.
Since that event, have you been having nightmares, unwanted memories or flashbacks about it, or feeling especially on edge and avoiding reminders of what happened?
No, I haven't been having any nightmares or flashbacks about what happened. I also don't think I'm actively trying to avoid reminders of it, though I just feel really overwhelmed by the stress.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling down most of the day or lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yes, I've been feeling really down and low almost every day lately. I've also lost interest in the hobbies I used to enjoy and just feel a lot of hopelessness. It's been really hard to shake this heavy mood.
Along with feeling down and losing interest, have you also had changes in sleep or appetite, low energy, trouble concentrating, or feelings of worthlessness or guilt?

I haven't really noticed any of those specific issues. My sleep and appetite seem pretty normal, and I haven't really felt guilty or struggled with concentrating. It's mostly just been the heavy, low mood.
How much is this affecting your day-to-day life, like work, school, relationships, or taking care of yourself?
Honestly, it has been quite hard to manage things in my daily life lately. I feel like I'm just going through the motions, and it's a real struggle to keep up with my usual responsibilities.
Have you had low energy or fatigue nearly every day during the past two weeks?
I haven't really noticed feeling constantly tired or low on energy over the past two weeks. My physical energy seems okay, it's really just my heavy mood that is the main issue.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or felt like life isn't worth living. It's just been a very heavy, sad feeling, but I don't have those kinds of thoughts.
Before this life change happened, had you already been feeling depressed or losing interest in things, or did those symptoms only begin after the stressor?
No, I wasn't feeling this way at all before the change occurred. These feelings of sadness and hopelessness only started right after that stressful event. Before that, I was doing completely fine.
Since this started, have you been feeling worthless or having excessive guilt, even when it doesn’t really fit the situation?

No, I haven't really felt worthless or experienced any excessive guilt since this started. It's mostly just been a deep sadness and feeling overwhelmed, rather than feeling down on myself in that way.
